brief: Australia sees easing inflation and political maneuvering, while Japan races rescue efforts after a deadly earthquake and US-China AI tensions escalate. Papers explore benchmarks for visualization annotation and LLM-based simplification of scientific summaries.
news_summary: Inflation eased to 3.8% in Australia, reducing rate hike chances; Japan earthquake death toll rises to 13; US bans new Chinese humanoid robots; Iran-US strikes continue.
papers_summary: AnnoBench provides a benchmark for visualization annotation generation, while a human-in-the-loop corpus studies LLM-based simplification of scientific summaries.

en.brief: Australia sees easing inflation and political maneuvering, while Japan races rescue efforts after a deadly earthquake and US-China AI tensions escalate. Papers explore benchmarks for visualization annotation and LLM-based simplification of scientific summaries.
en.news_summary: Inflation eased to 3.8% in Australia, reducing rate hike chances; Japan earthquake death toll rises to 13; US bans new Chinese humanoid robots; Iran-US strikes continue.
en.papers_summary: AnnoBench provides a benchmark for visualization annotation generation, while a human-in-the-loop corpus studies LLM-based simplification of scientific summaries.

zh.brief: 今日焦点包括日本九州地震致13人死、美伊相互打击打破短暂平静、特朗普暂停对伊战事引发台海安全讨论，以及中国使领馆外政治标语现象。研究方面，多篇论文探讨AI辅助可视化、代码审查中的可解释性及科学摘要简化。
zh.news_summary: 日本九州地震死亡人数升至13人，救援工作持续。美国与伊朗相互打击，打破短暂平静。特朗普暂停伊朗战事，美方担忧武器短缺及台海安全。中国使领馆外政治标语从重庆扩散至全球。
zh.papers_summary: 多项研究聚焦AI在可视化与代码审查中的应用，如AnnoBench基准测试、TailVis图表精炼、以及可解释AI对信任的影响。另有论文探讨LLM用于科学摘要简化及空间数据集成。

todays_image.caption: The fire truck door's urgent red embodies the scandal's heated revelations and the family's fatal crisis, both demanding a response that arrived too late.
